rules.text: Customers have 30 calendar days from the date the package is marked as Delivered to submit a return and refund request for eligible items.
rules.quote: Customers have the return timeframe specified at checkout or the default 30 calendar days from the date the package is marked as "Delivered" to submit a return and refund request.

rules.text: For customized Print on Demand (POD) products, eligible protected claims must be submitted within 14 days of delivery.
rules.quote: For customized Print on Demand (POD) products, eligible protected claims must be submitted within 14 days of delivery and include required supporting evidence.

rules.text: Refunds are issued to the customer at the seller's cost unless specified otherwise.
rules.quote: A refund is issued to the customer at the seller's cost, unless specified otherwise.

rules.text: Sellers are responsible for return shipping costs when the return reason is seller-fault; customers pay return shipping for buyer-fault reasons.
rules.quote: If at least 1 item in a batch is being returned due to a seller-fault reason, the seller is responsible for the return shipping fee.

rules.text: Sellers bear the cost of shipping the item exchange to the customer; TikTok Shop covers return shipping of the original item.
rules.quote: The seller will bear the cost of shipping the item exchange from the seller to the customer. TikTok Shop covers the cost of the return shipping of the original item.

rules.text: Sellers have 1 business day to review replacement requests without return; if no action is taken, TikTok Shop may auto-approve the request.
rules.quote: Sellers have 1 business day (excluding weekends) to review a replacement request. If no action is taken by the seller after 1 business day from when the request was submitted, TikTok Shop may auto-approve the replacement request.
